_doc: English for /DAT1/MGTIT.BIZ (Youth Diary 2 title menu and its memory-card messages). Kind B, common Latin glyphs; keyed by the stock string address because this screen's kanji rows differ from MENU.BIZ. Each slot is [ptr, 0, x, y] in pixels; the patch re-centres translated lines (20 px per glyph, 512 px wide). The stock pool holds 504 bytes and this screen has no spare room, so lines are kept short.
